mapper.sql: select i.id, i.issue_no, i.work_order_id, w.work_no, i.issue_time, i.doc_status, i.customs_status, i.execute_type, i.last_uuid, i.remark, i.del_flag, i.create_by, i.create_time from br_issue i left join br_work_order w on w.id = i.work_order_id
mapper.insert: insert into br_issue (issue_no, work_order_id, issue_time, doc_status, customs_status, execute_type, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{issueNo}, #{workOrderId}, #{issueTime}, '01', '00', '1', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update br_issue set update_time = sysdate(), last_uuid = #{uuid}, doc_status = #{docStatus}, customs_status = #{customsStatus}, execute_type = #{executeType} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: update br_issue set del_flag = '2' where id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into br_issue_item (issue_id, material_id, goods_source_type, goods_source_no, issue_qty, price) values (#{issueId}, #{materialId}, #{goodsSourceType}, #{goodsSourceNo}, #{issueQty}, #{price})
